# Fix fjall-hybrid

## Pull Request by @tomusdrw

To bring down the performance to actually match `lmdb-hybrid` for short fuzzing sessions.

Especially the picofuzz conformance tests has seen 7x slowdown due to frequent `resetState`

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Added support for reusing database sessions across operations, reducing resource overhead.
  * Optimized value persistence through batch writing for improved write efficiency.

* **Chores**
  * Updated fjall database dependency to version 0.2.0.

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Walkthrough

The PR introduces `FjallValuesSession`, a new exported class that wraps a `FjallRoot` and its immutable content-addressed `values` partition, exposing `persist()`, `sizeInBytes()`, and `close()`. `HybridSerializedStates` is refactored to use this session instead of directly owning `FjallRoot`; a new `fromSession` static constructor allows sharing an already-open session across instances without transferring ownership. Value writes switch from iterative inserts to a single `insertBatch`. `FjallRootOptions` gains an optional `cacheSizeBytes` field that is forwarded into the underlying fjall `open()` call. `HybridWorkerConfig.new` in the workers API gains a `sharedFjallSession` option, and the fuzz target is updated to open the fjall session once on first reset and reuse it across subsequent resets, closing it before the final directory wipe. The `@fjall-js/fjall` dependency is bumped from 0.1.3 to 0.2.0.

🎯 4 (Complex) | ⏱️ ~45 minutes

- [FluffyLabs/typeberry#628](https://github.com/FluffyLabs/typeberry/pull/628): Modifies `packages/jam/node/main-fuzz.ts` reset and shutdown logic, overlapping with the fuzz DB wipe and lifecycle changes in this PR.
- [FluffyLabs/typeberry#1001](https://github.com/FluffyLabs/typeberry/pull/1001): Adds `diskSizeInBytes()` plumbing into `ImporterStats`, which this PR connects to `FjallValuesSession.sizeInBytes()` in `HybridSerializedStates`.
